name: SEDANIA
recent: Sedania Innovator Berhad 在2026财年恢复盈利，并宣布将于2026年11月26日召开第十二届年度股东大会。公司近期完成了私募配售，发行4260万股新股，同时执行董事在闭市期间进行了股份交易。此外，公司2025财年审计报告包含与持续经营相关的重大不确定性及保留意见。
notable: 公司于2026年8月28日发布新闻，表示在2026财年恢复盈利。
公司完成私募配售，发行4260万股新股，发行价为每股0.1480令吉，并于2025年10月23日上市。
公司将于2026年11月26日召开第十二届年度股东大会。
risks: 2025财年审计报告包含保留意见及与持续经营相关的重大不确定性。
执行董事在闭市期间进行了股份交易，涉及30万股。
公司此前进行了私募配售，可能对现有股东股权产生摊薄影响。

events.what: 第十二届年度股东大会

recent_en: Sedania Innovator Berhad returned to profitability in FY2026 and announced its 12th Annual General Meeting to be held on 26 Nov 2026. The company recently completed a private placement of 42.6 million new shares, while its Managing Director traded shares during the closed period. Additionally, the FY2025 audit report includes a material uncertainty related to going concern and a qualified opinion.
notable_en: The company announced on 28 Aug 2026 that it returned to profitability in FY2026.
The company completed a private placement of 42.6 million new shares at RM0.1480 per share, listed on 23 Oct 2025.
risks_en: The FY2025 audit report includes a qualified opinion and a material uncertainty related to going concern.
The Managing Director traded 300,000 shares during the closed period.
The company previously completed a private placement, which may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
